title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 10: the new tablets, the ark of acacia wood, the tribe of Levi and what Yahweh requires.

questions.text: Of what wood did Moses make the ark?
questions.explanation: Moses made an ark of acacia wood and cut two stone tablets like the first.

questions.text: Where did Moses put the new tablets after he came down from the mountain?
questions.explanation: Moses came down and put the tablets in the ark he had made, as Yahweh commanded him.

answers.text: In the ark he had made

questions.text: Where did Aaron die and get buried?
questions.explanation: Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried.

questions.text: Who ministered in the priest's office in Aaron's place?
questions.explanation: After Aaron died, Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his place.

questions.text: Which tribe did Yahweh set apart to bear the ark of his covenant?
questions.explanation: Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark, to stand before him to minister and to bless in his name.

questions.text: Why does Levi have no portion or inheritance with his brothers?
questions.explanation: Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers because Yahweh is his inheritance.

answers.text: Levi was to stay in Egypt

questions.text: What does Yahweh require of Israel, according to Deuteronomy 10:12?
questions.explanation: He requires them to fear him, walk in all his ways, love him and serve him with all their heart and soul.

answers.text: To fear him, walk in his ways, love and serve him
To bring him a burnt offering every day
To build him a house of cedar in the land
To go back and make war against Egypt

questions.text: According to Deuteronomy 10:16, the foreskin of what must Israel circumcise?
questions.explanation: Moses says: "Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked."

questions.text: Why should Israel love the foreigner?
questions.explanation: They are to love the foreigner, for they were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

answers.text: They were foreigners in the land of Egypt
Foreigners brought them food in the wilderness

questions.text: With how many persons did their fathers go down into Egypt?
questions.explanation: Their fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons, and now Yahweh has made them as the stars of the sky for multitude.
